The issuer exhibits solid profitability and operating cash generation with revenue of $2,446M, an EBIT of $331M (13.5% operating margin), and net income of $230M. However, the financial risk profile is constrained by high leverage (Total Liabilities to Total Assets of 82.3%), a thin equity base of $565M, and a weak liquidity position evidenced by a negative working capital (current ratio of 0.91x). These fundamentals align with an investment-grade rating at the lower end of the spectrum, balancing strong earnings capacity against elevated balance sheet leverage.

DECISION: BBB-
